inspectionGroups.notes: Debug separation of the native optical assembly, not a manufacturer removal sequence or assembled spacing.

limitations: All represented STEP components, including open shells, retain their original millimetre assembly positions. Any omitted optional attachment is individually recorded; original STEP bytes remain complete. No nonuniform scaling or inferred circuit placement is applied.
CAD authoring date and Git commit date are source dates, not a claim of product release date.
RESET remains visible geometry only; platform reset is a separate action.
The live framebuffer overlays the native active face by 0.008 mm for rendering; this offset is not a physical laminate thickness.
Source photographs are unchanged references. Review registration and material colors do not certify mechanical fit, optical text-to-USB calibration or hidden dimensions.
Native components are not Boolean-unioned; any source assembly overlaps remain as supplied.
This model is SKU34961 without soldered headers. SKU34960 (-M) is a distinct header option; its additional header geometry is not represented by this base model.

The official AA dimensions 17.39×32.35 mm differ from exact 172:320 aspect by approximately 0.0108% due to published dimensional precision. The native physical dimensions are preserved, with normalized UVs and clipped corners.

WS2812 GPIO8 is mapped only to the actual native LED package under the LCD stack. It is naturally occluded in the assembled view and becomes visible when the optical stack is separated for inspection.
The 36.28 mm LCM drawing height describes the main display body. Native component0 also includes folded flex extending to37.00 mm; these extents are not forced into agreement.
PMMA and adhesive names mention S3; they are reused mechanical parts inside the explicitly C5 assembly, not a substitution of an S3 circuit.
